project.name: LendLoop
project.notes: Fictional neighborhood tool library: members list tools, borrow them, and return them. Used as the worked example in every step of the Field Manual.

planned.text: Members browse tools, request a loan, pick up, and return.
Owners approve or decline loan requests.

built.text: Catalog, tool detail, and 'My loans' pages exist.
No owner approval screen; loans are auto-approved.

gaps.text: No MVP cut-line: owner approval is described as core in README but never built and never explicitly deferred.

artifacts.name: Backbone + MVP cut-line
artifacts.content:
Backbone: Discover -> Request -> Pick up -> Return

Discover: browse catalog | view tool detail
Request: request loan | (owner) approve/decline
Pick up: see pickup info
Return: mark returned

--- MVP cut-line ---
Below: ratings, waitlist, owner approval (deferred to v2)

built.text: User 1-N Tool (owner), Tool 1-N Loan, User 1-N Loan (borrower).

gaps.text: No written API payload contracts; POST /api/loans accepts fields not validated by any zod schema.

artifacts.name: ERD

planned.text: API endpoints will be covered by request tests.

gaps.text: No API test collection of any kind (no .bru, Postman, or HTTP test files).

artifacts.name: List tools

planned.text: Catalog shows a spinner while loading and an empty state.

built.text: Catalog has Populated and Idle (empty) states.

gaps.text: Catalog has no Loading and no Error state; a failed fetch shows a blank page.

planned.text: Seed script with realistic fake data for demos.

built.text: Prisma schema with 3 models and a Faker seed creating 10 users, 30 tools, 50 loans.

gaps.text: Seed is not idempotent: running it twice duplicates rows.

artifacts.name: Ticket for GAP-FIGMA-01
artifacts.content:
Feature: Catalog loading and error states

  Scenario: Catalog fetch fails
    Given the tools API returns 500
    When I open /tools

    And I see a "Try again" button
